nom: CHANEL LA MOUSSE Camellia Cleansing Cream-to-Foam

avis.texte: I absolutely love this cleanser! The foam is so rich and creamy, and it makes my skin feel incredibly clean without leaving it tight or dry. A little product goes a long way, so I know this tube will last me a while. It has a light, luxurious scent that's not overpowering, and it makes washing my face feel like a treat. After using it for a few weeks, my skin feels softer, smoother, and looks more refreshed. I would definitely repurchase and recommend it to anyone looking for a high-end cleanser that's gentle and effective.
This turns into such a nice lather and is extremely gentle on my skin. A little bit goes a long way so I feel like I'm getting my money's worth. Will definitely repurchase!

Chanel kindly gave me this La Mousse Camellia Cream-to-Foam Cleanser for free so that I could share my honest review. The first thing that I noticed was how luxurious the packaging is. It looks beautiful sitting by my sink. It only took a small amount of product to work into a beautiful lather, and was overall an enjoyable cleansing experience. The only thing I didn't care for was the scent, as I am sensitive to fragrance in skincare. I would only consider repurchasing this cleanser if there was a fragrance free version.

avis.titre: Luxury Cleanse Without the Stripped Feeling
avis.texte: I received this product in exchange for my honest opinion. I've been using CHANEL La Mousse and it's a luxury cream-to-foam cleanser that leaves my skin feeling really clean and smooth. A little goes a long way, and it foams up into a dense, cushiony lather that feels great to use. It removes daily grime, sunscreen, and light makeup easily, but I still prefer a separate remover first for heavy or waterproof makeup. My skin feels fresh after rinsing, the rich creamy cushy foam makes it a pleasant after was feeling. My skin doesn't feel tight or dry. Overall, it's pricey, but if you like a deep-clean, foamy cleanser with a polished, spa-like feel, it's a solid pick.

The Chanel La Mousse Camellia Cleansing Cream‑to‑Foam feels like a little spa moment in your daily routine. It starts as a creamy texture that turns into a rich, soft foam to wash away dirt, sunscreen, and light makeup without stripping your skin. It leaves my face feeling clean, refreshed, and comfy, not tight or dry, and a little goes a long way. Lots of people say it's gentle and hydrating while still really effective.
I received a free sample to try and lives it!!!Fresh clean scent. Luxurious lather. Leaves your skin feeling soft but not greasy. Removed my makeup but didn't make my face feel tight

avis.titre: Gentle, Creamy Cleanser That Leaves Skin Feeling Fresh
avis.texte: I received this product for free from BzzAgent and CHANEL in exchange for my honest review. The CHANEL LA MOUSSE cleanser is a luxurious-feeling face wash that turns from a rich cream into a soft foam. It immediately elevates the cleansing experience with its subtle scent and silky texture. A little goes a long way, and it effectively removed sunscreen and light makeup without stripping my skin. After rinsing, my face felt clean, smooth, and balanced, never tight or dry. I have combination skin that leans dry in winter, and this worked beautifully without causing irritation or breakouts. That said, it may not be ideal for heavy makeup removal on its own—I'd recommend using it as a second cleanse or pairing it with a makeup remover. Overall: A well formulated everyday cleanser that feels indulgent but performs well. Perfect for those who enjoy a sensorial skincare step that doesn't compromise on results.

I received this product for free, in exchange for my honest review. I went into this expecting that I would absolutely love it. I mean, it's Chanel so it's got to be great, right? I was wildly underwhelmed with this product. My first complaint is the smell. It smells like a very mature floral, more of a smell that my grandmother would love than myself. My next complaint is the texture. It felt like rubbing wet lotion on my skin, which apparently I'm not a huge fan of. It left my skin feeling unclean, and stripped of all moisture. I don't know if it's just my skin or not (I have combination-oily skin) but it didn't work for me. It seems like one of those products that you'd put in a guest bathroom to show off the brand, but not actually use. I think there are many, many better products out there for far cheaper and better quality.

I've been trying this face wash for a few weeks in order to see the results and I love it! It's has a refreshing and clean scent that is not overwhelming. As for the application, a pea sized amount is enough to cover your whole face. It is a very smooth application and foams well when rubbed in. It's a gentle cleanser that cleans my face without leaving it dry or flakey. I am so glad they sent me a tube to review. It is my new favorite product! I am going to be purchasing more!

I received this face wash and immediately ran to try it. The packaging was so beautiful I enjoyed unboxing it. I used a small pea sized amount and got a rich and luxurious lather that gave my skin the perfect clean feel. Non stripping and moisturizing. This facewash is perfect for daily use! The smell is very soft and not overwhelming even for early morning use. I would recommend and would definitely buy again even at this price point because a little goes a long way and last.

La Mousse is hands down one of the best cleansers I've used. The texture transforms into a rich, creamy foam that feels luxurious and gentle on the skin. It cleans thoroughly without drying, leaving my face soft, smooth, and perfectly balanced. My skin feels fresh and refined after every use, and the elegant Chanel experience makes it even more enjoyable. Truly a staple in my skincare routine. I personally bought several for family and friends during the holiday season. Absolutely worth it.

I'm picky with my face washes but I was very pleasantly surprised by this one! I use this wash as part of a double cleanse routine (with the wash being step 2). I really like the fragrance, it reminds me of a fancy spa. The face wash also left my face feeling so clean but not stripped of my oils. I also noticed that I didn't need too much product to get enough lather for my face. I am totally hooked on this product now and will certainly repurchase it when I run out!

My skin is on a dry-ish side, therefore, finding a good cleanser is a bit problematic for me, so I'm always on a hunt for a good cleansing product that would not dry out my skin. This time I received La Mousse Camellia Cream-to-Foam cleanser from Chanel complimentary to try in exchange for my honest review through the BzzAgent Sampling program. I knew this was going to be a good product since I had tried another cleanser from the same brand a few years back and I loved it. This one has barely any scent, more like soapy, which is what I prefer in skincare. It's very gentle on my skin and made it squeaky clean without drying it whatsoever. Once you apply it on your wet skin, it starts off like a cream of mask even. Then once you add more water on top of it, it transforms into a foam. I love that 91% of the ingredients are naturally derived, which makes it gentle on your skin. In addition, it has a moisturizing barrier component, which not only makes your skin clean but also nourishes it. Overall, I'm very impressed with the product and will definitely purchase more in the future.

I live on the east coast and it winter where winter came a little earlier than expected. The air is extremely dry and my other face wash was not cutting it anymore. I have sensitive skin and don't like to use harsh products. This face wash felt amazing on my skin and made it extremely soft. I had no irritation or redness. I'm a dual face cleanser so I use this in the morning and at night, and I noticed a huge difference in my skin and my opinion and made me look a little bit younger. I gave my face a youthfulness appearance. The cleanser starts off as a cream and then as you add water to it, it starts to foam making my skin feel super clean.

Im in love with the la mousse cleanser from Chanel, it leaves my skin looking radiant and refreshed. There isnt much of a scent which is okay for me since Im not the biggest fan of scented cleansers, it lathers really well a little goes along way and its easy to use, the packaging is easy to use but my only complaint is the packaging isnt that nice considering this is a Chanel product I would expect something more luxurious but its still a cleanser that sits on my sink proudly. I'd recommend to any chanel lover out there.

This was a pleasant surprise- I've never had the cream to foam texture in a product and I wasn't sure I would like it- turns out I love it. It feels almost like a face cream going on so I was sure it wouldn't feel totally clean- by rinse, my face felt clean, but not that stripping "squeaky clean" where you feel like all the moisture is gone. My face feels refreshed and clean, without that tightness or dryness.

This cleanser has a rich, creamy texture that lathers nicely and leaves my skin feeling clean without feeling tight or dry. It removes daily makeup and impurities effectively while still being gentle on my skin. I appreciate how soft and refreshed my face feels after each use. The formula feels luxurious and a little goes a long way, making it easy to incorporate into my daily routine. Overall, it's a solid cleanser that delivers consistent results.

avis.titre: Skin feels so soft and moisturized
avis.texte: Chanel La Mousse Camellia Cleansing Cream-to-Foam feels luxurious from the first use. The creamy texture transforms into a soft, rich foam that cleanses thoroughly without stripping the skin. My skin feels clean, smooth, and comfortably hydrated after every wash. It's gentle, beautifully formulated, and perfect for daily use when you want an elevated cleansing experience.
Chanel skincare products are always top notch quality and this cleanser stands out! Easy to use and leaves my skin unbelievably clean and fresh! I recieved this product in exchange for my review.

avis.titre: A luxurious, gentle cleanser that leaves skin clean, soft.
avis.texte: I really enjoy using La Mousse Chanel as part of my daily skincare routine. The creamy mousse lathers beautifully and leaves my skin feeling clean, soft, and refreshed. It doesn't dry out my skin and has a subtle, luxurious scent. A little goes a long way, making it feel worth the splurge.

This cleanser provides a luxurious leather that effectively removes dirt and product without stripping moisture out of my skin and doesn't irritate. A little goes very long way, so this is actually a great value at this size. I look forward to this as a staple in my end of day care routine.

What a special treat this luxurious high end cleanser is! I look forward to washing my face with this twice a day! It smells divine and is so soft and gentle on my skin. It leaves my face feeling clean and moisturized. Well worth investing in!

avis.titre: A cleanser that leaves skin truly balanced
avis.texte: I've been using Chanel La Mousse Camellia Cleansing Cream-to-Foam for a while now, and it truly feels like a luxury experience every time I wash my face. A small amount goes a long way once you add water, it transforms into a rich, soft foam that cleanses thoroughly without stripping my skin. My skin feels incredibly clean, smooth, and refreshed afterward, never tight or dry. It removes makeup, sunscreen, and daily buildup easily while still feeling gentle and comforting. The texture is creamy before lathering and the scent is subtle and elegant, not overpowering at all. What I love most is how balanced my skin feels after using it, calm, hydrated, and prepped perfectly for skincare. It's definitely a splurge, but the quality, performance, and overall experience make it worth it. This cleanser feels like self-care in a tube, and I'll absolutely keep it in my routine. I received this product for free in return for my review but my review is my honest opinion.

The package it came it was stunning and hefty! The cap is heavy and large. When squeezed, the product comes out the texture of butter. It quickly turns into a bubbly foam, and smells heavenly! Product rinses clean and leaves skin soft, supple, and lightly scented. 5 out of 5 stars!

avis.titre: LOVE! Absolutely will buy this product again - no hesitation
avis.texte: I received the Chanel LA MOUSSE Cleanser for free through the BzzAgent sampling program, and I'm honestly in LOVE with it. From the first time I used it, my skin felt so clean and refreshed. It has this really silky texture that turns into a lovely lather, and it just makes my face feel super soft and smooth afterward. It absorbs so well - and quickly as well. I don't get that tight or dry feeling I sometimes get with other cleansers, which is a huge plus. It really does make my skin feel fresh and hydrated, and the whole experience just feels luxurious. Compared to other cleansers I've used, this one feels way more indulgent. Most other products leave my skin feeling either stripped or not really all that clean. This one feels like it actually does the job without making my skin feel like it's been over-cleansed. It's a great balance of deep cleansing and gentleness. The texture, the scent, the way my skin feels afterward - it all just feels so luxurious. Its like a mini skincare spa session. I would definitely buy this. It sucks that it's on the pricier side, but it's totally worth it for how great my skin feels after. Plus, it doesn't take much, so I know this bottle will last a while. I would 100% recommend this to anyone looking to upgrade their skincare routine. If you want something that makes your skin feel amazing and adds a touch of luxury to your day, this is the cleanser to try.

The scent is the most beautiful floral scent that makes cleansing a spa experience! Pleasantly surprised with how effective the cleanser is at removing makeup and sunscreen even removing the majority of my extra waterproof mascara! I know it is not necessarily meant to be used as a cleansing balm but I wanted to test the cleanser in different trials. It is not stripping even on my eczema prone skin that was having a flare up prior to using this cleanser I had to layer 3 different moisturizers to keep it from flaking meanwhile immediately after washing my skin feels throughly clean but not stripped of all moisture. It doesn't clog pores nor cause breakouts either in my acne prone skin. I would definetly recommend it and as frugal as I am even I would splurge on this product! Disclaimer: I received this product free from Bzzagent for testing purposes but the opinions expressed remain 100% my own honest thoughts.

Chanel La Mousse is the epitome of luxury! My skin never felt so soft and smooth after cleansing! The smell is amazing, it truly feels like a spa treatment every time I cleanse my face. I had used Chanel skincare years ago and had stopped after they reformulated some of their products. After trying La Mousse, I will definitely be returning to Chanel skincare again!

I think this product was almost perfect. It lost me with the heavy fragrance though. I don't normally mind fragrance in any of my products but this one was overpowering and wasn't pleasant. But, it definitely had some pros. It worked really well to wash my makeup off and felt very thick and luxurious. It didn't leave my face feeling dry, oily or tacky like some other cleansers have. The size of the squeeze bottle was a good amount, especially since you only have to use a little bit of product at a time. It lathered up quite nicely and left my face feeling refreshed, clean and ready for my moisturizer. Thanks for the free sample opportunity.

Camellia cleansing cream to foam was given to me for free in exchange for an honest feedback. Initially the product is rich and creamy but with the water contact it transforms into silky enveloping foam! It's a very elegant formulation with a beautiful scent and it leaves the skin clean and glowing. It goes well with my camellia face cream, their whole line is my favorite!

This is an absolutely stunning face wash that I love having displayed on my counter. The product comes in a branded squeeze tube with a lixuriously embossed cap. It leaves my face feeling squeaky clean after each use and the cream to foam action is gentle. It does have a slight scent for those who are sensitive.

I used this product nightly to remove make up. It left my skin clean without drying my face like some cleansers do. The scent was very mild and did not linger. It lathered very nicely and rinsed off easily. I liked its in squeeze bottle so you don't have to worry about a pump getting clogged

avis.titre: Luxurious and gently facial cleanser with a nice, clean sent
avis.texte: I first tried this cleanser after a night out, fully expecting it to struggle with my waterproof mascara, but it didn't. It removed my makeup without me needing to scrub my eyes too hard and without stripping my skin or leaving that tight, squeaky feeling afterward. My face felt clean but still comfortable, which is hard to find in a cleanser that actually works. Yes, it's pricey, but it's Chanel. Plus, you get a generous amount of product, so it feels worth it. The packaging is also a win: sturdy, well-designed, and practical. I love that you can stand it upside down and let gravity do the work when it's running low. Overall, if you're looking for a gentle, yet effective cleanser that feels luxurious and lasts, this one is absolutely worth the money.
It's very lightweight and doesn't leave that "crunchy" feeling that some brands seem to leave behind. Lasts ALL day! I only have to refresh it when I wash my hair! Definitely worth the asking price!

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: I love how smoothly the cream feels on my face as I am washing my face. It leaves my face feeling clean afterwards

This cleanser didn't seem to cause any breakouts or sensitivity, but my skin did feel a little tight after using. It didn't have a strong smell but my skin tends to be very sensitive to added fragrances in skincare so I'm afraid long term use of this cleanser would eventually cause irritation. I like the camellia ingredients, but I don't notice any other benefits. Overall, this is a no frills cleanser that's not worth the price.

I got this cleanser for free in exchange for my honest review. This cleanser has a thick creamy texture. I only need a pea size amount and it foams up very well to clean my face and neck and ear area without stripping my skin. I follow up with a liquid toner and my skin feels nice. The smell is nice and not overwhelming. For the price of this product and the amount I actually need to use on daily, I think it's worth it.
This product is amazing. I love the way my skin feels after using it. It's such a gentle cleanser and I would recommend it to anyone, can't wait to try another product from this line!
I'm loving the Chanel mousse it's such a great cleanser and very gentle on the skin.
I have super sensitive skin so I have to be very picky about what I put on my face and I love this! The ingredients are natural and it removes makeup so well.

I love a great cream to foam cleanser, as it great product to use while I shower. A little goes a long way, this cleanser builds up nicely with a little bit of water. My face feels nice and clean immediately after using the cleanser without feeling stripped out or dry.
This is a really good cleanser. It really cleans my skin and removes everything. My skin feels so hydrated after cleansing. I love the look of the bottle and it's a perfect size.

I have to say im a no fuss type of girl when it comes to anything I'm putting on my face. I knew I had nothing to worry about when it came to testing the CHANEL La Mousse. I know CHANEL is a luxury brand that stands behind their products and after using the La Mousse it has been a game changer for my completion. It cleans & clarifies my skin without leaving it over dry. I love the soft velvety texture and the way it leaves my skin with a soft clean glow. Im combination skin but can be more dry especially in these winter months. I think this face wash is perfect for any skin type. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. All thoughts & opinions are mine.

Incredible and most luxurious facial cleanser! It was so gentle and made my skin feel so good after. Didn't strip my face of its natural oils and did not make my skin dry like other cleaners. Love the formula!! And such a beautiful bottle. Love the packaging! Would highly recommend this product to friends and family. I received this product complimentary for testing purposes.

avis.titre: A great way to pamper winter (or summer!) skin
avis.texte: I had never tried this before so i wasn't sure what to expect. I gave myself a few weeks to try using the products everyday for an honest review. I didn't expect to fall in love but it did (isn't that always the way). It is a joy to use this every day, in a world where many luxury brands feel less and less luxurious, Channel came to say she's that girl. The cream is rich and thick and foamy and feels comforting as soon as you apply it. It is not overly harsh and does not strip your vital skin barrier. My skin has shown improvement in skin barrier and moisture/plumping. I hate to say it, but when you know you know. Its a new classic for me.

avis.titre: I would buy it again but not as a staple
avis.texte: I really liked the texture of this cleanser, especially for the winter. It's very creamy and moisturizing and lathers amazingly. Also THE SMELL is so nice ugh. The cleanser itself did leave my skin feeling very clean and soft. I used it for a couple weeks but wouldn't say I noticed a significant difference in my skin as in I don't know if it dramatically improved my skin in any way that my usual (cheaper) cleanser did. While the cleanser is nice and smells amazing, I'm not sure I'd use it as a staple due to the price but I def would buy it to have it around for days when I want to feel luxurious.
Applies nicely, strong cleanser not harsh, nice smell, nice packaging

I was hesitant at first!!! There was initially a rosy type scent that very much became minimally noticeable. some of the cleanser to foam facial washes i've tried do NOT foam enough to feel like they thoroughly cleanse my skin. This was different!!! This cleanser is worth the hype because it definitely exceeded standards for a cleanser to foam face wash. And left my skin feeling clean -- not the squeaky clean feeling but clean.
Nice and hydrating for the dry Denver climate. Particularly helpful in winter! It has a light scent and feels luxurious going on the skin. Such a nice addition to my skincare routine!

The price may feel steep but you get a lot of product and only need a small amount per use! Great texture and really gives you that clean yet not stripping feel. Would highly recommend. I received this product for free from bzzagent in exchange for my review.

A little goes a long way as you can lather up the product before putting it on your skin to cleanse with. The foam feels really nice on the skin and upon rinsing, the skin can feel a little on the tight side but I like to use hyaluronic acid at that time to prevent that. It smells good but not overwhelming and the bottle should last you for a while.

I really enjoyed using this product. My skin always felt so refreshed and soft after applying it. My skin can be sensitive to new products, so I was happy to see that LA MOUSSE was both gentle and effective. I'd recommend it! I received this product in exchange for an honest review.

This Lamoose is a good cream to foam cleansing mousse. It takes off, make up really easily and I like using it all over my face except near my eyes. My only qualm with it is that it might be over scented. I wish it was slightly less.

avis.titre: This is an amazing luxury cleanser!
avis.texte: This cleanser makes me feel so pampered and lush! It's gentle on the skin and has a soft, subtle scent. I really enjoy washing my face with this first thing in the morning. I definitely recommend to anyone who wants to splurge.

avis.titre: An experience more than a cleanser
avis.texte: Disclaimer: I got this for free as part of a review program. From the packaging to drying your face this is an experience! Not my daily cleanser though. Some specifics: - Using this feels like being at the spa, the texture, the smell, it's all subtle yet leaves a luxurious feel on your face. - A little goes a LONG way. In comparison to other higher end cleansers you get more value for similar prices. - This is not a daily cleanser for me, which is fine because I usually rotate. I have sensitive skin so usually go for a softer cleanser, and I gravitate towards this 1-2 times a week for a deeper cleanse. While I work in a city I'm not outdoors a lot of the time so I usually just want a gentle wash for most days, and with my skin on the drier side this might be a bit harsh for me if I used it daily. When I lived in NY, for example, this would make a bit more sense to use more often. Overall, I'd purchase this as a gift for friends whether their skin types align with mine or can sustain more. Again, it felt more like an experience! Loved for long self care days especially.

I was sent this product to test, and overall I did enjoy it. It foamed up really nicely. I didn't find it drying, and I feel that it really did a great job of cleansing my skin. The only potential drawback that I found was that it is scented. I didn't mind the scent too much, though I did notice a bit of irritation on my neck a couple of times after use and my neck tends to be more sensitive to perfumes than my face. If you are super sensitive to scents this might be a problem for you. It is a pleasant scent, but I think that it could work for more people if it was unscented. Overall I did enjoy it and would use it again.

Honestly, I'm really impressed with this cleanser. I use it when I'm double cleansing, especially when I'm wearing makeup, and it works great! It also smells really good and isn't too overpowering. The packaging is super luxurious, definitely makes the price worth it!

I have "temperamental" skin. This hands down made has calmed my skin, it's light yet leaves my skin feeling extremely clean and fresh. I am sensitive to smells as well and this again has a clean but very light light smell. I would had never thought to buy a "luxury designer" face wash. But this has sold me. I will absolutely continue to use this!!! I have ranted and raved about it that my niece also has purchased privately and has enjoyed it as well!! 10 outta 10!!!

Chanel did their thing with this cleanser! First and foremost the unboxing experience is always top notch with this brand which I love ! The texture of the cleanser is very unique as it starts as a cream and then foams up while you are washing your face! It's very refreshing and smells amazing ! Left my skin feeling very clean and extremely hydrated! I received this product in exchange for my review!
I was sent this to try. This feels like a luxurious cleanser going onto the skin. This is a great cleanser because it gets the daily dirt and sebum off but doesn't feel overly dry or stripping.

As an initial disclaimer, I received LA MOUSSE Chanel complimentary in exchange for my candid assessment. From the moment it arrived, the product's presentation was impeccable. The packaging exudes the classic elegance synonymous with Chanel, truly elevating the unboxing experience. Its sophisticated design and premium feel make it an exceptional gift choice for anyone who appreciates a touch of luxury in their daily routine. The subtle fragrance is another highlight. It's a delicate, signature scent that's neither overpowering nor artificial, perfectly enhancing the cleansing ritual without lingering heavily on the skin. Regarding its performance, this cleanser creates a rich, luxurious foam that effectively purifies the skin. As someone with an oily complexion, I found it remarkably efficient in lifting away daily grime, excess oil, and even stubborn makeup, leaving my skin feeling thoroughly clean and refreshed. Crucially, unlike many cleansers formulated for oily skin, LA MOUSSE Chanel does not strip the skin of its natural moisture. After use, my face felt beautifully soft and supple, completely free of any tightness or dryness, maintaining a comfortable balance.

I've been using this product to wash the day off my face before bed. I'm so impressed at how well this product removes makeup, nourishes my skin and leaves my face feeling supple and baby soft. An added bonus is the beautiful fragrance of the camellia flower. This product feels luxurious and is the perfect self-care splurge.

This is so smooth and feels truly luxurious. The cost is pretty steep but the results and feel show its worth. My skin is dry, my son is teen and the opposite- on both this wash left our skin soft, clean but not stripped. I would recommend this to any skin type, and I will purchase when I am finished with my complimentary tube.

avis.titre: Wow! This is luxury in a tube
avis.texte: Beautiful packaging, smooth and creamy, then foaming cleanser. It's soft and gentle but effective. I received this for free in exchange for writing a review, however I would buy this on my own again and again!!

I love how the creamy texture transforms into a soft, airy foam. It cleanses thoroughly without stripping my skin, leaving it fresh, smooth, and comfortable. My skin feels soft and balanced after every wash, not tight at all. The subtle, luxe fragrance makes it feel like a mini spa moment—perfect for both morning and night cleansing. Totally recommend it
It's great for sensitive skin and smells so luxurious! The packaging is luxurious!

I love this foam so much. The foam on this is amazing. The first wash takes all my makeup on. The second wash it cleans tos by perfection with no makeup residue. The scent is light not over powering. You only need a tiny size less than a nickel size. This will last a long time so that justifies the price. I highly recommend.

avis.titre: Decent for a non-skincare brand cleanser
avis.texte: It cleans well, a little too well for sensitive/dry skin. Left me feeling a little too stripped and squeaky clean. Packaging is boring, and the scent is reminiscent of old lady, but that's Chanel for you. All that said, it does make me feel fancy for using a luxury bland for something so silly as a cleanser. Wouldn't outright buy, but I'll enjoy using it as a splurge. Thanks for the free sample!

avis.titre: Do not think about it, just buy it!
avis.texte: I completely fell in love with this cleanser, I began using it one time in the morning and before bed, and the results were overwhelming almost instantly! My skin not only felt extremely clean, but it looked soft and radiant. I truly don't think I can go back to my regular cleanser after this, I'll stick to this one for now!

I've been really enjoying using this mousse cleanser and it has become a staple in my routine. Usually I double cleanse with cleansing balm first before I go in with a foaming cleanser, but one time I forgot and this cleanser was able to remove all my makeup. It lathers beautifully into a luxurious mousse and it has a light scent that makes this very enjoyable to use. The packaging is convenient. I love it so much!
This product does a great job of washing off grime and grease. I even use it to remove makeup.

The La Mousse cleanser may be a new holy grail product. I have dry, sensitive skin and this face wash is so creamy and gentle that it leaves my skin feeling fresh, clean and hydrated. A little goes a long way, and keeps my skin glowing. It does seem to have a gentle fragrance, just something to be aware about if you're sensitive.

This cleanser creates a rich foam from a small amount of product and leaves skin feeling deeply clean yet soft—not tight or stripped. It effectively removes sunscreen, oil, and light makeup, and works well both alone or in a double cleanse. The scent is elegant but noticeable, which may not suit fragrance-sensitive skin. While pricey, the concentrated formula makes it last a long time and feel like a worthwhile splurge for normal to oily skin types.

I am typically someone who is nervous to try new products on my face as I don't want to risk breaking out or the complexion I have going at this point. I received this product free and was able to provide review and I honestly love it. It has a lightweight scent that smells fresh, but it is not overpowering. I am someone who always buys fragrance free so coming from someone like that it's late enough to not cause an issue. It comes out almost like a lotion and then foams up. I use it as a part of double cleansing and it helps get all the access make up and dirt off my face. Great product and would recommend!
Thick, luxurious and fancy is how I would describe this Chanel cleanser. Comes in a fancy Chanel box (which contains another box). If they didn't test on animals I'd be more inclined to repurchase!

avis.titre: Definitely must buy and keep on repeat
avis.texte: Love to use the Chanel La Mousse as part of my nightly routine. Smooth to foam texture going on. Rinses clean and face feels fresh.

The smell and texture of LA MOUSSE are divine!! It is like going to the spa every time you wash your face! I now look forward to washing my face every single day just so that I can use this product. It comes out thick and creamy from the bottle and transforms into a creamy lathering foam on the skin that leaves 0 residue or film. I LOVE how clean (but not dry or tight) my skin feels after using this. I was sent this product in exchange for a review, but I will absolutely buy this product when I run out!

avis.titre: A Cleanser That Feels Gentle Yet Effective on My Skin
avis.texte: I didn't expect a cleanser to stand out this much in my routine, but CHANEL LA MOUSSE ended up being one I genuinely enjoy using every day. From the first wash, it felt more like a comfort step than just something to rinse off quickly. The cream feels dense at first, but it lathers easily with water into a smooth, airy foam. It spreads well across the face and feels very gentle, almost soothing, while still giving the sense that it's actually cleaning the skin. The fragrance is refined and light, adding to the overall experience without being distracting. What really makes a difference for me is the after-feel. Once rinsed off, my skin feels fresh and clear, yet never tight or dry. There's no residue left behind, just soft skin that feels calm and balanced. Even when I've been wearing sunscreen or minimal makeup, it cleans thoroughly without needing to rub or overwork the skin. With regular use, my skin has felt more stable and comfortable overall. It doesn't promise instant transformation, but over time my complexion looks smoother and feels healthier. CHANEL LA MOUSSE has become one of those cleansers that quietly does its job well and makes my routine feel more refined. If you're someone who values a gentle cleanse that still feels effective, this is definitely worth considering.

Thank you Chanel for sending me this product to try and review! Overall la mousse felt like a really luxurious cream cleanser. It didn't foam as much as other cleansers I've tried but it feels like a rich cream thick lather. It feels really nice at the end of the day. My face feels moisturized and soft. I personally love the light scent. It's on the pricier side but a little goes a long way so the tube will last a while.

I like the thicker consistency. It doesn't lather up in a bubbly sense, but it makes a watery, creamy consistency. It goes on thick and washes off easily. It makes my skin feel clean and moisturized. It has a pleasant scent. Would recommend!

avis.titre: Luxurious Cleanser That Feels Like a Treat
avis.texte: I've been using Chanel- La Mousse daily as my cleanser, usually in the morning and sometimes at night. A small amount lathers into a rich, creamy foam that feels incredibly soft on the skin. It cleans thoroughly without leaving my face feeling tight or dry, and my skin always looks fresh and smooth afterward. I also love the light, elegant scent that makes washing my face feel spa-like. Overall, it's a high-quality, luxurious cleanser that makes my skincare routine feel elevated.

This cleanser works wonders on my skin. It creates beautiful, soft, luxurious, creamy foam. It effectively removes all my makeup and impurities, leaving my skin super soft to the touch. My skin looks bright and radiant every time I use this cleanser. Plus it smells absolutely amazing. Holy grail in my beauty book.

Now you might think, why spend so much on a product where others may do the same. Let me tell you that THIS is different. First of all, price - it's not that expensive compared to others I've used. It starts off creamy then turns to foam which just glides softly and smoothly over your delicate facial skin; but strong enough to wash away the day's dirt and help repair the damages. It takes off make up very easily. Subtle fragrant, some may say none at all. I've noticed a different in the feel and softness of my facial skin since using this and highly recommend it!

[I got this product for free to try and leave my personal review] Chanel La Mousse Cleansing Cream-to-Foam is a luxurious daily cleanser that turns a rich cream into a soft, airy foam on contact with water. It cleanses my skin thoroughly without stripping the skin, leaving it feeling fresh, smooth, and comfortable. The formula feels gentle yet effective, removing excess oil and light makeup while maintaining hydration. With its elegant texture and subtle scent, it makes cleansing feel like a refined skincare ritual—ideal for those who enjoy a polished, high-end cleansing experience.

I was able to try this product for free and I will definitely be purchasing when finished. This cleanser is so thick, rich and creamy! It foams up nicely and removes all make up in one wash. My face is so soft and clean feeling. I'd say it's best for oily skin, and might be a tad drying for dry skin.

I received this product from Chanel in exchange for my opinion and I am truly obsessed with the high end quality to begin with the packaging is so upscale and pretty. The cleanser is a cream that quickly builds to a foam and only requires a small amount to cover your face. Leaves my skin feeling soft and fully cleansed melting away makeup.

I love this cleanser; I have dry skin and this cream cleanser works great at cleansing but not stripping away too much moisture from my face. My face feels plump and hydrated each time I use it. The smell is also great, it's a lovely floral scent that makes my cleansing routine highly enjoyable. It will also last you a while, you only need to use a little bit each time! I was kindly given this cleanser for free so that I could review it.

For the first time I found a cleanser that actually leaves my skin feeling clean. It doesn't make my skin feel overly dry but I do feel clean. It also doesn't require that much do I consider it a bang for your buck. 2-3 cm of the product length wise should suffice.

Let me start by saying I am not a big face wash person and typically switch between different brands. However, this is absolutely my new forever face wash. This is amazing — my skin has genuinely never looked better, it feels legitimately squeaky clean, and leaves me feeling so refreshed! I am already looking at travel sizes because I don't want to be without this for my recent travels
Foam/cream consistency. Has a very light perfume scent not to strong very light. Washed my face using this skin felt very nice and clean this is also great because it removes my makeup well too.

This is a cream to foam facial cleanser that has an amazing fragrance and seems suitable for a lot of skin types. Personally I have oily, acne prone skin and am prone to breakouts. This cleanser has kept my skin clean yet hydrated and nourished. It builds up a great lather and also has an amazing scent. I use this product twice daily, once in the morning and once at night. I would say that the scent may be a bit too strong/perfume-y for a facial cleanser but personally I don't mind the scent. I would recommend this product to my friends and family. I recieved this product for free in exchange for writing this review.

avis.titre: Nice smell and does not leave your skin dry
avis.texte: This cleanser has beautiful smell that make me really relax when using it. It does the job, clean my face but does not leave it dry after. Overall I think it is a good product, but there could be more since the rice is in the higher end

The La Mousse Cleanser from Chanel is one of the best cleansers I've tried. When squeezed out of the tube it is a very thick consistency that foams up when rubbed in yours hands with water. It is incredibly hydrating and leaves my skin feeling clean, soft and moisturized after use. As someone with very dry skin I really value a cleanser that doesn't strip my skin and make it feel drier than it already is. This does have a pretty strong fragrance, which is typical with designer skincare and beauty products. It doesn't bother me but if you're sensitive to fragrance it's something to consider. This is obviously a pricy cleanser but a little goes a very long way and after using it for over 3 weeks I've barely put a dent in it so it will definitely last a long time. All in all it's a cleanser I'd recommend to anyone wanting to try some designer skincare. * I received this product for free from Bzzagent and Chanel in exchange for my honest review.*

I received this product as a gift in return of an honest review. I tested this product out for over a week and a half to be able to give a good review and make sure I didn't get any breakouts as a result of this product. To start, you need very little of this product because it is thick and then lathers to foam so much! I used far too much in the photo I have attached. This is a good thing because the product will last so long! It starts as a thick cream and with water lathers beautifully. It removes all my makeup and leaves my face feeling squeaky clean! The reason I took a star off was because the product is heavily scented and that is a negative for many. All in all, I loved this product and felt it did an amazing job cleansing my face!
This cleanser is the most luxurious cleanser I have ever used. The texture is great and it smells amazing. I will be using it for life!

I have been using this for a few weeks, and I'm glad I took the time to play with it. At first, I used a nickle sized amount, and it was way too much! It left a film on my face that wouldn't go away. After experimenting, a pea sized dollop leaves my skin clean, moisturized, and soft. I still use an oil cleanser first, but I do find myself reaching for this, as it feels like a luxury. * I did receive this product in exchange for an honest review. *

avis.titre: Classic Chanel quality and good packaging
avis.texte: I use this as a face wash. It definitely is a true cream to foam. It's very thick but turns into a very lush foam. It smells very clean slightly perfumey but nothing overwhelming and it did not irritate my skin and I have sensitive skin. I do love Chanel based products. I even use their face cotton, so this wash was definitely something that I went in with high hopes and it definitely delivered. I will keep this as a new go to for a face wash.

I received this beautiful Chanel La Mousse for free in exchange for writing a thoughtful and honest review. I can easily say with certainty that this face wash is the best! It smells amazing while also making my skin feel so soft, clean, and glowing. Chanel is the epitome of luxury and sent the product in the most beautiful packaging. I use it every night before bed followed by the rest of my skincare regimen. It is not too heavy and foams up nicely. Doesn't leave skin feeling dry or sensitive. I love it and I definitely recommend it for daily use! :)

avis.titre: This cleanser is just amazing! I only want this from now on
avis.texte: I received this complimentary from bzzagent and Chanel in return for my honest review. I am so very impressed with this cleanser ! The packaging is not too much nice and understated. The fragrance is nice and not too overpowering at all . It foams up so nicely and only takes a little bit. It feels like it cleans my face so well and makes my skin so soft as well I am just in love with it ! My skin rinses off nice and clean and feels like nothing else I've used. I want this cleanser forever! I will be buying more when I run out for absolute sure. I wont be without it !!

I used this cleanser morning and night for over two weeks and it's easily become one of my favorite face washes ever. A small amount foams up really well and leaves me skin feeling exceptionally clean but still soft and comfortable, not tight or dry! It does remove makeup well but I've been using it as my second cleanser so that's not its daily task. I love the texture, the light scent, and how smooth my skin feels afterward. I have sensitive skin and this has not caused irritation or breakouts at all. The only downside is the price, but the quality matches it and the bottle lasts longer than expected. Overall it feels like a true luxury cleanser that actually performs.

I REALLY like the Chanel La mouse cleanser. It smells so rich and luxurious. It lathers so nicely on my face and does a good job removing makeup from the day. I did find it a bit drying while it's also winter here, so I need to alternate with a heavily hydrating cleanser and moisturizer. Other than that, I think it's great

This face wash lathers up more than any I've ever used and you need only the smallest about to cover your entire face. The smell is stronger than most face washes, but it's a pleasant, floral scent. The only small downside is that there is a slight squeak to the skin after the product is rinsed, but that feeling does go away quickly. I find my face feels more hydrated after using.

CHANEL's Mousse Crème to Foam Cleanser delivers a luxurious cleansing experience that feels both effective and indulgent. The rich cream transforms into a soft, airy foam upon contact with water, making it a pleasure to use and elevating an everyday skincare step into something special. It thoroughly removes makeup, sunscreen, and daily impurities without leaving skin feeling tight or stripped. After rinsing, skin feels clean, smooth, and refreshed, with a comfortable, balanced finish—never dry or squeaky. The formula works well for normal to combination skin and is gentle enough for daily use.

The Chanel La Mousse cleanser works well for my combination, acne-prone skin. It has a creamy consistency that foams up well, so a little goes a long way. It's very gentle and leaves my skin feeling clean and soft without any dryness or irritation. I use it both morning and night, and it works well as the second step in a double cleansing routine. I like the light, pleasant fragrance. The packaging feels very nice and luxurious. I got this product in exchange for an honest review.

I've been using Chanel La Mousse Cleanser for a while now, and it's become one of those products I genuinely look forward to using every day. The texture is what won me over first, and a small amount lathers into this rich, cloud like foam that feels incredibly luxurious on my skin. It cleans thoroughly without ever feeling harsh, and after rinsing, my face feels fresh, soft, and balanced rather than tight or stripped. I love how it removes daily makeup and impurities effortlessly while still being gentle enough for regular use. There's also that subtle, elegant Chanel scent that makes the whole experience feel like a mini spa moment at my sink. Overall, La Mousse feels like a refined, high quality cleanser that elevates my routine and leaves my skin consistently clean, comfortable, and smooth.

avis.titre: An essential part of my daily skincare routine.
avis.texte: would like to thank Chanel and BzzAgent for the opportunity to try La Mousse. Chanel has always been my favorite brand, from its elegant packaging to its exceptional quality. The packaging features Chanel's signature black and white colors, which are simple yet stylish and refined. The Camellia Cleansing Cream transforms into a rich foam upon use. The texture is thick, so only a pea-sized amount with a small amount of water is sufficient for the entire face. The foam is smooth and soft, with a light and gentle fragrance. After cleansing, my skin feels fresh, smooth, and soft, without any dryness or irritation. After using this product for over two weeks, I can confidently recommend La Mousse to my friends. It has become an essential part of my daily skincare routine.

CHANEL La Mousse is a cleanser that feels luxurious from start to finish. The cream texture is thick and silky, and once water is added, it turns into a light, fluffy foam that feels very gentle on the skin. Cleansing with it feels more like a pampering step than a basic routine. It effectively removes everyday dirt, oil, sunscreen, and light makeup without leaving the skin feeling dry or tight. After rinsing, the skin feels clean, soft, and comfortable, with a smooth finish that lasts. It's especially nice for those who want a thorough cleanse while still protecting their skin's moisture. The formula is highly concentrated, so only a small amount is needed each time, which helps balance out the luxury price. The scent is soft and refined, adding to the overall experience without being overwhelming. Overall, CHANEL La Mousse is ideal for anyone who enjoys high-end skincare and wants their cleanser to feel both effective and indulgent. It turns an everyday step into a moment of self-care.

avis.titre: A Luxurious Cleanse That Truly Delivers
avis.texte: I absolutely love Chanel La Mousse Cleanser. The texture is rich and creamy, and a small amount goes a long way. It lathers beautifully and leaves my skin feeling deeply clean without that tight or dry feeling. My face feels soft, fresh, and comfortable after every wash. It also has that subtle, luxurious Chanel scent that makes cleansing feel like a spa experience. Perfect for daily use, especially if you want a cleanser that's gentle yet effective.
Smells amazing, leaves skin feeling so soft and refreshed great product would definitely buy

I like this cleanser because it is a cream to foam formulation. the foam is very fine does. It provide a full lather. Just slightly bubbles up on the skin but still looks creamy to me. It also is very scented which I feel makes my skin flare up and for people with sensitive skin that much fragrance is not necessary. outside of those cons, the pros were smooth application and an amazing clean feel after rinsing the product off. It is quite stripping of the oils in your face, which I think leads to that very clean feel on the skin so heavy moisturizer following cleansing with this product is important. all in all if they were to release a fragrance free version, it would be my number one choice for facial cleanser, but with the amount of fragrance in it, it literally smells like a body fragrance and that's no good for my acne prone skin.

I received this product to sample and review. I have combination skin and wear makeup almost daily. It will not take off your make up, but it did make my skin feel very clean. A little goes a long way! This product will last for a very long time. The smell is heavenly and I really enjoyed the lather. I can't give it 5 stars for these reasons: -it was a little too harsh for me -the packaging. Having a twist top cap wasn't very convenient. Otherwise, great product.

This beautiful cleanser is a pleasure to use. It's gently foaming and feels very effective, while also being soft and lightly hydrating on the skin. Using this cleanser isn't just a step in one's skincare routine—it's an experience!

I have loved using the LA MOUSSE cleanser from Chanel. I have never experienced such a good cleanse with one product! I love the soft scent and how much my face really feels refreshed after I use it. Continued use has given me the softest feeling skin which makes me so happy.

avis.titre: Takes off all dirt and grime
avis.texte: This product feels so luxurious at the end of the day. It has just enough lather and I can feel the dirt and grime coming off without leaving that overly clean feeling

I love using the Channel La Mousse facial wash. It is very thick so you only need a small amount. It lathers up nicely and feels very luxurious. It leaves my face moisturized and I feel like it has improved my appearance. I highly recommend this product if the price point is in your budget.

I really love this cleanser. The cream turns into a soft, luxurious foam that feels gentle on the skin. It cleans well without drying or irritating, leaving my skin soft and fresh. Light, elegant scent and a little goes a long way. Highly recommended.

avis.titre: Ok but there's better out there
avis.texte: I used the face wash for a few days. It's very creamy which I liked, the packaging is cute. It does what it should but it left my face feeling a little to squeaky and almost like it was stripping my face. Which I didn't love. It's overall ok but I think there's better out there. I received this product for free for review.
This is a soft and gentle moisturizing face wash. Bottle has luxe feel and product also feels really thick and nice! Does not dry you out. Packaging is suburb!

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I love the consistency it's thick creamy feeling , so a little goes a long way , and it lathers very nicely. It has a soft scent to it. It didn't dry my skin and it felt smooth after use. My skin feels very clean after I use it , it removes make up nicely . I would highly recommend this product to others .

So my skin gets super dry in the winter and no matter what I do I always have some skin peeling until I tried this. This face wash made me realize I was stripping my skin with other products I had been using. Definitely an investment that is worth it!

avis.titre: A Luxe Cleanser that Truly Delivers
avis.texte: I absolutely love this cleanser. It's rich, luxuriously smooth, removes makeup effortlessly, and leaves my skin soft and refreshed. I've been using it morning and night followed by serum and moisturizer, and compared to other products I've tried—including the French olive oil soap I was using before—La Mousse is on a completely different level. It's a luxe cleanser that truly delivers. While it is pricey, I absolutely intend to repurchase. You only need the smallest amount each time, so it's surprisingly cost-effective and one tube will last a long time. My mature sensitive skin and I love La Mousse and recommend it without hesitation. Thank you to Chanel for gifting me the Chanel La Mousse Cream-to-Foam Cleanser in exchange for my honest review.

I've used La Mousse for two weeks now, and can say that it feels seriously luxurious on the skin. The formula is rich and not drying at all. My only criticism is the scent but I am admittedly sensitive to scents. Otherwise this is such a lovely formula and can't wait to repurchase.

I did not know that face wash could feel so luxurious! I received Chanel's LA MOUSSE face wash for free to review. I'm actually obsessed. I have combination skin and rosacea and my skin can be sensitive to new products, but this face wash has been so effective and so gentle. It's cream to foam and feels so soft and cushy going on, but is effective at removing dirt, oil, and sunscreen. I've been using it twice a day for a week and my skin feels so fresh, clean, and radiant. I've actually been receiving a lot of compliments on my skin since I started using LA MOUSSE. I haven't had any issues with drying or stripping and my skin feels healthy and hydrated. I usually stay away from scented products, but find that the soft, floral scent has enhanced my experience with this product. It feels and smells so luxurious that I actually look forward to washing my face at the end of the day! It is a little expensive for a facial cleanser, but I have found that you can use a very small amount and still have a full face lather, so I think it's worth it!

avis.titre: I will definitely be purchasing this item again and again!
avis.texte: I am rather picky about facial cleansers, but absolutely love this one. The scent is light and refreshing and not overpowering whatsoever. It goes on as a cream, but soon films and lathers up beautifully. I have noticed an incredible difference with how my facial products are sitting on my face and the texture of my skin. I have definitely found my new favorite cleanser.

avis.titre: Unique texture that leaves skin feeling fresh and clean
avis.texte: The Chanel La Mousse cleanser is luxurious in texture and fragrance. I enjoyed how it lathered into a creamy foam. Once rinsed off, it did leave my skin feeling clean, but not stripped. The downside is that it burned my eyes. I will use it as a morning cleanser, but would not use it to remove eye makeup.
